messages.subject: Marldon - the 1,200 vs 1,900 point
messages.plaintextBody:
Team,

Thackeray Wolfe are running the "you overloaded it" line and quoting 1,200 mg/l as the design basis. Our enquiry data pack of 9 January 2024 says 1,900-2,200. That document wins us the liability argument if it holds up. Elena - please make absolutely sure we have the original sent version with metadata, not just a later copy.

Next: we should brief counsel on merits and quantum, and start thinking about a claimant Part 36 once we have her view.

Sarah Whitfield

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
